item.title: Rapides Parish Police Jury to hold special meeting today
item.description: The Rapides Parish Police Jury has scheduled a special meeting for Thursday, Feb. 19 at 3:30 p.m. at the Rapides Parish Police Jury Meeting Room, located at 701 Murray Street in Alexandria. The agenda includes consideration of items requiring action by the Police Jury. The meeting is open to the public.
